tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal nag po chen po'i gtor chen gyi 'khor lo'i gzer bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// rdo rje nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// rnal 'byor pa la mi shigs rdo rje'i go /phas kyi byad ma mkhan gyi srog gi gshed// lhag par dgra bo tshar gcod mtshon cha'i sde// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srung bar 'di na 'ongs// dpal nag po chen po'i sgo nas bdud kyi g.yul 'joms pa'i gtor chen la gces pa'i 'khor lo mi 'chug pa gzer du stems pa ni 'di ltar/ dang por srung ba'i 'khor lo steng du 'bubs pa la mu khyud rim pa bcu bdun du bskor ba'i dbus su chos 'byung gru gsum bsnol ba'i lte bar/ bla ma dang yi dam gyi gzungs sngags bri ste/ oṃ badz+ra gu ru ḍā ki nī sid+dhi hūm̐/ dang*/ bde mchog yab yum gyi snying po nye snying ngo*// zur drug la bhūm̐/ rtsibs mchan la che ge 'khor dang bcas pa'i rkyen phyi nang gi bar gcod thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ de'i phyi la nag po chen po'i srog sngags bcu bdun pa/ yum chen gsum gyi sngags/ 'dod gsol/ de'i phyir/ re ti'i sngags/ oṃ ma hā kā li aḥhūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ka ro li maṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ kaṅka li hraṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ka la ra tri raṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ sgo ma'i sngags/ oṃ gṛ dha s+ya gu ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bha ga byā gh+ra ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bha na su bh+ra ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ si ma ma ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bha na ṣe ṇaṃ s+yaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ kro na dha ka kyai hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ u lū ka s+yai hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ga ru ṇa la ghu s+yai hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ de'i phyir pad 'dab brgyad la/ snya dzaḥhriḥbaṃ/ ni dzaḥ.aḥtaṃ/ she tsa/ u laṃ/ ha dzaḥhūm̐ me/ pu dza/ hūm̐ waṃ/ de'i phyi ma le tshe bdun du btang la sras mchog mgon po bzhi dang*/ nying sprul las mgon gsum yum dang bcas pa'i sngags/ de'i phyir/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā ya k+ṣa ya badz+ra tsa ha shān+ti shān+ti shag byer yar yar staṃ bha ya byer/

mo ha ya byer/ dzaṃ bha byed ya bzlog bh+yo/ oṃ wā ga k+ṣa ya badz+ra dhi han tsa ha man/ oṃ tsat+ti ṣan+ti k+ṣa ya badz+ra tshin+dha tsa ha man 'dra/ ma ma kā ya wā ga tsit+ta ban+dha khrol/ de'i phyir rtsibs brgyad la/ mgon po bka' brgyad kyi srog sngags/ rtsibs mchan la/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa shwa rī ye swā hā/ oṃ ru ru ma ma bh+yo/ oṃ tsartsi ka ye swā hā/ oṃ u ma de wī dzaḥ.oṃ ka li ka ye swā hā/ oṃ tsā mun+ḍi dza/ oṃ ku li shi ṣe ye swā hā/ oṃ shad+ga pa li dzaḥde'i phyir rtsibs brgyad la/ gsung dkyil lha mo brgyad/ rtsibs mchan la/ oṃ shān+ti k+ṣe pa hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ka la dhi pa hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā smṛ ti hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dza ya bha lan hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bha lan su hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bhe su bha ga hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ shaṅka ri hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ war+ṇa pa na hūm̐ phaṭ/ de'i phyi'i mu khyud la gsung dkyil sgo skyong spyi sngags/ rgyas par 'dod na mngon 'byung du gsungs pa bzhin pho nya mo drug cu rtsa bzhi dang zhing skyong so gnyis kyi sngags bri/ de'i phyi'i rtsibs brgyad la sde brgyad mgon po'i sngags/ rtsibs mchan la phyogs skyong gi sngags/ de'i phyir rtsibs bcu la khro bo bcu'i sngags ni/ oṃ āḥ.uṣ+ṇī ṣa tsa kra warti hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥya mān+ta kri ta hūm̐ hū?m̐/ oṃ āḥ.a tsa la hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpra dz+nyān+ta kri ta hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥṭak+ki rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥsum+bha rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpad+mān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥnī la daṇ+ḍa hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥbi gh+nān+ta kṛ ta hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥm hā ba la hūm̐ hūm̐/ rtsibs mchan la/ steng gi gdon thams cad rak+ṣa/ de bzhin/ shar sogs rigs bsgre'o// de'i phyi'i mu khyud la/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ na maḥs man+ta dharmā rnāṃ/ na maḥs man+ta saṃ ghā nāṃ/ oṃ si tā ta pa tre/ oṃ bi ma la/ oṃ shaṅka ra/ oṃ pra d+yad+gīr/

badz+ra uṣ+ṇī ṣa tsakakra warti/ sarba yan+t+ra man+t+ra/ mu la karma pan+dhā nāṃ/ dā ḍa naṃ ki la ni ba/ ma ma kṛ ti/ ye na ka na tsit+ta kṛ tān+tād/ sarban+tu tshin+da tshin+da/ bhin+da bhin+da/ tsi ri tsi ri/ gi ri gi ri/ mā ra mā ra/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ de'i phyi'i rtsibs bcu drug la/ hrī ཿhūm̐ spel ma/ rtsibs mchan la phaṭ mgo nang bstan/ de'i phyi'i mu khyud la rtsa sngags kyi mthar/ u u u sarba de wa la/ sa ma ya dzaḥ.o o o sarba de wa a/ sa ma ya dzaḥ.u ne u ne aṃ ku sha dzaḥ.oṃ ma ti 'ur pa nan khrol/ lce ti 'ur pa nan khrol/ tsit+ta 'ur pa nan khrol/ mal te phye/ sa ma ya khrol/ che ge mo'i lus ngag yid gsum bcings pa dang gzir ba thams cad phye phye khrol khrol ma ma dha ra kā ya wā ga tsit+ta rak+ṣa ku ru swā hā/ de'i phyir phyag mtshan mtshon cha'i rigs thams cad bri/ de'i phyir dbyangs gsal bcom ldan 'das dang rigs gsum mgon po rnam 'joms/ ye dhar/ oṃ sarba bid+yā swā hā/ de ltar nang ma'i mu khyud phal la che ge mo'i lus ngag yid gsum la mi dang mi ma yin gyis gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa thams cad dang phas kyi rbad 'dre rbod stong byad zor rig sngags dregs pa'i dmod pas gzir ba sogs gnod pa sarba rak+ṣa ku ru swā hā/ de'i phyi ma'i mu khyud la bung ba khrag 'thung bzhin gyi bzlog sngags yig mgo phyir bstan/ de'i phyir me ri/ phyi rol mi'i g.yang gzhi rngam par bri'o// dmag la sogs pa bsrung bar 'dod na/ bung ba khrag 'thung bris pa'i nang du mu khyud gcig bsnan la/ dngos grub 'byung ba bzhin beng gi rtsa sngags mthar// dmod byang dang bcas pa bri'o// bzlog pa'i 'khor lo ni/ mu khyud dgu pa la lte bar chos 'byung nang du srog sngags bcu bdun pa/ zla gam gsum la yum sngags/ de'i phyir rtsibs bzhi la re ti bzhi'i sngags/

rtsibs mchan la bh+yo bzlog de'i phyi'i rtsibs gsum la sras mchog gsum/ rtsibs mchan la/ oṃ la ki ni la liṃ lu leṃ loṃ la/ oṃ ḍā ki ni dhaṃ dhiṃ dhuṃ dheṃ dhoṃ dha/ oṃ ka ki ni kaṃ kiṃ kuṃ keṃ koṃ ka de'i phyir rtsibs bzhi la mdun nas g.yas bskor gyis las mgon sde bzhi'i sngags/ rtsibs mchan la hrīḥtsaṇ+ḍi ka'i snying po rak+ṣa se aṅku sha dza dza/ oṃ sa ki ni saṃ siṃ suṃ seṃ soṃ sa/ ra ki ni raṃ riṃ ruṃ reṃ roṃ ra/ oṃ ha ki ni haṃ hiṃ huṃ heṃ hoṃ ha/ de'i phyir rtsibs brgyad la mgon po brgyad kyi sngags/ rtsibs mchan la be con/ de'i phyir yum brgyad kyi sngags/ de tshun yig mgo phyir bstan/ de'i phyi ma la bzhi snying*/ de'i phyir beng sngags/ de'i phyir bzlog sngags/ de nas me ris bskor ro// bya khyung gi 'khor lo ni/ mu khyud rim pa lnga bskor ba'i lte bar bud+dha ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭ/ ye shes khyung gi ltas ngan pa thams cad dgra la bh+yo bzlog de'i phyi'i mu khyud la/ oṃ kaṃ kaṃ bha ni lan bha ma ku ru bhi sa ha ra hūm̐ phaṭ/ pha rol gyi byad dang rbod gtong gi gnod pa thams cad bzlog par gyur cig de'i phyir rtsibs bzhi'i mdun ma la/ oṃ badz+ra ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ rat+na/ oṃ pad+ma oṃ karma rtsibs mchan la/ rdo rje'i khyung gis ltas ngan pa thams cad dgra la bh+yo bzlog rin chen khyung gis/ pad+ma'i khyung gis/ las kyi khyung gis/ de'i phyi'i mu khyud la/ oṃ sarba ga ru ṭa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭ/ ma hā kā li ha ba la ha bha ra kha rag gnod byed byad ma lha srungs dang bcas pa ma ra rbad/ mā ra ya myog myog mā ra na sod sod/ sna tshogs khyung gis byad dang rbod gtong ltas ngan pa thams cad dgra la bh+yo bzlog de'i phyir gdong pas gdong can gyis ltas ngan pa thams cad dgra la bh+yo bzlog sder mos sder can gyi mchu yis mchu can gyi rwa yis rwa can gyi lto bas ltos 'gro'i ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig

ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu glo bur bdun brgya nyi shu/ byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu/ chags che nyam nga thams cad dgra la bh+yo bzlog de thams cad yig mgo nang*/ de'i phyir me ri/ de'i phyir khyung gi gzugs/ de'i spyi bor bde mchog yi ge bdun pa'i sham bu ye shes lha'i bka' chad bzlog gshog pa g.yas srid pa pho brgyud bzlog pa'i phyir/ dang por/ oṃ ma hā kā la spro ma ri ma ri sha trag thum bh+yo/ gnyis par/ e ka pa ra hṛ da hṛ da du kha tshe du kha tshe bh+yo/ gsum par/ oṃ a kro te shwa ri mañju ya mān+ta ka ha na hūm̐/ bzhi par/ ya ya bra ma ra kri kar/ lnga par/ du pa sha rbad phye dhi bh+yo/ g.yon pa mo brgyud bzlog pa'i sngags ni/ dang por/ oṃ ma hā kā la ya ma ra tsa ya bh+yo/ gnyis par/ ma mo snying kha rag mā ra ya thun bzlog /gsum par/ ma ma tri ma mā ra sha sha hed hed thun bzlog /bzhi par/ ma mo kye thun pra ma yi sna ga sha/ lnga par/ thun bh+yo/ mjug sgro la sa bdag klu gnyan bzlog pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ ma hā kā la ga ru ṇa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ta ke tsa ki bya tsa ti/ hu ya hu ya/ na ga hu lu hu lu/ su ru te su ru te swā hā/ gsung dkyil ba'i 'khor lo ni/ mu khyud lnga'i lte bar/ oṃ badz+ra tsartsi ka yai na maḥganas yul dur khrod kyi ye shes dang las kyi ma mo rnams kyi che ge mo'i mi mthun phyogs thams cad bzlog par gyis shig de'i phyi la zhing skyong gi srog sngags/ de'i phyi la rtsibs brgyad kyi mdun ma la zhing skyong so gnyis kyi sngags las dang po thugs sngags/ oṃ k+ṣeṭa pā la ha ha ho hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ki li ki li pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ/ k+ṣaṃ k+ṣaṃ/ k+ṣu k+ṣu/ ka ha ka ha/ hri+iṃ hriṃ hriṃ hriṃ/ pa ts+tsha pa ts+tsha/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ de'i phyi'i rtsibs brgyad la gsung*/ ha ha ḍa ḍa/ raṃ raṃ raṃ raṃ/ kruṃ kruṃ kruṃ kruṃ/ khaṃ khaṃ khaṃkhaṃ/ ru ru ru ru/

ḍaṃ ḍaṃ ḍaṃḍaṃ/ kaṃ kaṃ kaṃ kaṃ/ tsaṃ tsaṃ tsaṃ tsaṃ/ de'i phyi'i rtsibs brgyad la sku sngags/ kraṃ kraṃ kraṃ kraṃ/ saṃ saṃ saṃ saṃ/ baṃ baṃ baṃ baṃ/ yaṃ yaṃ yaṃ yaṃ/ bh+ruṃ bh+ruṃ bh+ruṃ bh+ruṃ/ k+ṣaṃ k+ṣaṃ k+ṣaṃ k+ṣaṃ/ klaṃ klaṃ kluṃ kluṃ/ paṃ paṃ paṃ paṃ swā hā/ de'i phyi'i mu khyud la pho nya drug cu'i srog sngags kyis bskor te/ oṃ bhai ra khi nī swā hā/ ru tri ni/ ḍa ṣa kā ra li ni/ dzā la mu khi naṃ/ bha yu bhe ke ni/ pra tsaṇ+ḍi ni/ ru tra a k+ṣi ni/ ma hā ṇa se ni/ a pa ni/ ya ma ni/ ki ri ni/ lak+ṣī ni/ bi dza yi ni/ shrī dzā na ye/ shri dzā ya ka ra ṇī/ shri badz+ri nī/ ki ka li ni/ kā la rā tri ni/ pra kro ta mu khi nī/ kā la dzi hā nī/ kī ra li ni/ badz+ra bhai re pa ka ra nī/ dhu ru si nī/ ya ni ma/ na ad+ga ri ni/ smra ka ra ba teṣ+tha nī/ rat+na ma li ni/ su yak+ṣi ni/ ku su li ni/ kha ta tri nī/ badz+ra pra bha nī/ badz+ra kā la ya nī/ ma sa pañca ni/ ka ma ni bhi/ tsi tra li ka nī/ shu ki nī/ sarba nri ni/ su tra ri nī/ ga la pa nī/ pad+ma ak+ṣi nī/ dza la dza la kha ti bha wa shud+dhi nī/ shri gho ra nī/ tsan+t+ra le ka nī/ tsaṇ+ḍa mu khaṃ nī/ hi sa warmi nī/ wa ge me shwa rwa nī/ ghi ta ru tra ye/ ka rani so ga bhi tu pa ni/ mṛ ta ni dhi/ gha ri ṇa/ sha ṣo nī/ pu shi gh+raṃ nī/ bhan+du bha ra nī/ shri mu khi nī/ pi ka li nī/ ka li nī/ ha ri niṣ+ṭha ye/ pad+mi nī/ na gra pa ak+ṣi nī/ bhi ma la tsan gh+ri ni swā hā/ bak+ṣa bak+ṣa sarba yo gi nī/ ka me shwa ri/ sarba duṣ+ṭa gardza gardza gṛ h+na gṛ h+na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ de'i mthar gnas yul dur khrod kyi dpa' mo dang mkha' 'gro rnams kyis che ge mo la pha rol mi dang mi ma yin pa'i byad zor sngags kyi sbyor ba thams cad byad ma kho rang la bh+yo bzlog nad rims dal kha thams cad dgra la bzlog gzhan 'khor lo rnams kyi lte ba 'gyur/ gzhan de kha bas g.yas bskor rim pa bzhin/

oṃ badz+ra baiṣ+ṇa bh+yai na maḥ.oṃ badz+ra wā rā h+yai na maḥ.oṃ badz+ra ku mar+yai na maḥ.oṃ badz+ra ma he shwar+yai hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā lak+ṣ+mai hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra in+d+yai na maḥ.oṃ badz+ra bra h+ma n+yai na maḥsde brgyad kyi 'khor lo kun la lte bar hūm̐/ lha'i mgon po dbang phyug chen po 'khor bcas kyis lha'i gnod pa thams cad dgra la bzlog par gyis shig de'i phyir lha'i mgon po'i srog sngags dmod pa dang bcas pa/ de'i phyi'i rtsibs brgyad la/ mgo nas g.yas bskor gyis// oṃ bra h+ma hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ṭak+ki pa ri hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ in+t+ra hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ u pan+d+re hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ rā h+ma ṇa hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ biṣ+ṇu hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ karti ka hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ga ṇa pa ti hūm̐ phaṭ/ de'i phyir shā sa na/ de'i phyir bzhi snying*/ de'i phyir bzlog pa bung ba khrag 'thung me ri gsum po 'di kun la 'dra'o// bdud mgon la/ ya ma ra tsa hri dzaḥm mo ha sa maṃ hri dzaḥ/ tsa tsa shu la ra tsa hriṃ dzaḥtsa giṅka ra hriṃ dzaḥr rak+ṣa hriṃ dzaḥdu bdung pra ma ya hriṃ dzaḥphu la na ga ra phu dzaḥtri dza badz+ra sa dhu tri hriṃ dzaḥgashin rje la rtsibs brgyad la/ ya ma rā dza sa do me la/ ya me do ru ṇa yo da la/ ya da yo ni/ ra ya k+ṣa ya/ ya k+ṣe ya tsh+tsha ni ra ma ya/ rtsibs mchan la/ dza pa ru ṇa/ ni ra tsā ni/ gza' la/ mu le ka pa sha mi ki rā hu la dza dzaḥbyi na ya ka pa sha mi ki rā hu la dza dzaḥb ga she ge ta pa sha mi ki rā hu la dza dzaḥrak+ṣa ka ha sa sha mi ki rā hu la dza dzaḥ.oṃ mā rak+ṣe pa sha mi ki rā hu la dza dzaḥ.oṃ ya ma ka ta pa sha mi ki rā hu la dza dzaḥ.oṃ khe tshe ri ha ha na ma la hab hab tri pa sha mi ki rā hu la dza dza ཿnā ga sho ga ya pa sha mi kī rā hu la dza dzaḥklu'i rtsibs brgyad la/ oṃ ba ru ṇā ye swā hā/ oṃ a nan+da ye swā hā/ oṃ rak+ṣa ye swā hā/ oṃ shaṃ ka ku li ye swā hā/ oṃ karko ṭa ye swā hā/ oṃ pad+ma ye swā hā/

oṃ ma hā pad+ma ye swā hā/ oṃ ku li ka ye swā hā/ btsan la/ oṃ shu la tsa hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ a bhi shu hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ a sha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ a ti pa ra hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ kha ta kha ta hūm̐ phaṭ oṃ shan ku ru hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ a pa pa ha hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ na tsa tri hūm̐ phaṭ/ gnod sbyin la/ oṃ saṃ pra dza na ya swā hā/ oṃ ghu h+yes+ṭha na ya swā hā/ oṃ pañci ka ya swā hā/ oṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li ye swā hā/ oṃ dzam bha la dza len+d+ra ye swā hā/ oṃ pur+ṇa bha drā ya swā hā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha drā ya swā hā/ oṃ ku be rā ya swā hā/ ging gi mgon po la/ oṃ pu tra hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ rā dza sarba hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bha tra hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ haṃ shaṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ e ka dza ra hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ru tra hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ rtse sma ra hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ mu na mu hūm̐ phaṭ/ mnan gtad la dgos pa klu bdud nag po'i 'khor lo ni/ dngos grub 'byung ba las/ tshad dang ldan pa'i 'khor lo ni// mu khyud bzhi pa bri bar bya// gru gsum nag po sa bon bcas// las rnams byed pa rlung yig dang*// ma hā kā la 'bru bzhi dang*// steng gnon oṃ dang badz+ra te// zhes pas 'khor lo bzhi mu khyud bzhi/ dang po/ lte bar gling dgur bcad pa'i dbus sogs gling lngar/ rlung dkyil yaṃ dang*/ lte bar oṃ badz+ra/ gling bzhir ma hā kā la/ nang gi gru srin mo'i btson dong bzhir/ dgra bo'i ming mthar hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ de'i phyi'i mu khyud la bzhi snying*/ de'i phyir pad 'dab brgyad la sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi sngags re re'i mthar/ bya rgod gdong can mas dgra bo 'di rengs par gyis shig stag gdong mas bskrad par gyis shig phag gdong mas smyor 'jug par gyis shig ce spyang mas nang dbye ba/ khyi gdong mas rnam par rmongs pa/ khwa ta'i gdong can mas rnam par gnon pa/ 'ug gdong mas khrag drang ba/ khyung gi gdong can mas brgyal ba'i las/ de'i mu khyud la klu bdud nag po'i srog sngags/

oṃ nag po ti pa tsa ya/ nā ga rāk+ṣa na ga kā la du ra du dza hūm̐/ e nag po ti pa tsa ya/ nā ga rāk+ṣa/ gnod byed he khugs laṃ phe shan phos phos/ shig shig chuṃ chuṃ/ hu ya hu ya/ klu bdud nag po mgo dgu pa che ge mo'i srog la mā ra ya dza dzaḥ.ai phe laṃ shaṃ/ nag po ti pa tsa ya/ yag sha nā ga kro tī shwa ri/ tri shan rbad/ pu ru rak+ṣa rbad/ ti pa tsa ya kha la baṃ/ che ge mo sha trūṃ mā ra ya rbad/ nag po baṃ tsi tsi rgyas/ drag thur/ snying thur gul gul myag rtsa bzhi skuṃ shan shan/ srog la shan/ thur sod thur sod/ che ge mo mā ra ya/ tri thur sod/ yaṃ raṃ laṃ khaṃ/ che ge mo nri 'byung ba bzhi'i nad kyi mā ra ya thibs sod/ de'i rtsibs ling brgyad la/ sa bdag nag po ro langs rus sbal mgo dgu pa sa ga du/ nā ga nag po baṃ ro la drag thur mā ra ya sod/ dgra bo'i pho rgyud khyod la zas skal du gtad do/ gnyis par/ gnyan rje nag po sdig pa'i mgo dgu pa/ tri ga na nā ga nag po baṃ/ snying la gul gul che ge mo mā ra ya/ zha rengs kyis sod cig dgra bo'i bu rgyud khyod la zas skal du gtad do// gsum par/ klu srin nag po chu srin gyi mgo dgu pa/ oṃ ma hā tri shab sha /nā ga nag po baṃ/ che ge mo rtsa bzhi skuṃ skuṃ mā ra ya sod/ dgra bo'i mo rgyud khyod la zas skal du gtad do/ bzhi par/ klu btsan nag po sha ba'i mgo sbrul gyi gdengs ka dgu pa/ oṃ sha nā ga na tri tsa ra ya/ nā ga nag po baṃ/ che ge mo shan shan srog la shan mā ra ya rbad/ dgra bo'i spun pha spun rnams khyod la zas skal/ lnga par klu gza' nag po bya mgo dgu pa/ oṃ ra tri pa la nā ga nag po baṃ/ che ge mo thur thur srog la thur/ mā ra ya sod/ dgra bo'i 'khor tshogs khyod la zas skal/ drug par klu rgyal nag po srog len stag mgo sbrul gyi gdengs ka dgu pa/ oṃ tri ra tsa ha la nag po baṃ tsat+ti dbugs la sring sring sod mā ra ya rbad/

dgra'i sgo nor thams cad khyod la zas skal/ bdun par/ klu thel nag po wa'i mgo oṃ sa du ra ha la ya nā ga nag po baṃ/ che ge mo'i sha la shan shan mā ra ya sod/ dgra bo'i lo thog thams cad khyod la zas skal du/ brgyad par klu bdud nag po dom mgo oṃ nā ga du tri ha la sa ti/ nā ga nag po baṃ/ che ge mo'i srog khrag myags thum ril mā ra ya rbad/ dgra bo'i sgo phyi thams cad khyod la zas skal du/ de'i mu khyud la klu bdud kyi 'bod rbad bsad khram gyi sngags/ de'i phyi'i ling tshe brgyad la/ ra dza tri yaṃ dgra bo'i sha la rbad che ge mo'i rnam par shes pa rgyun chod cig rgyal po shing bya can khyod la dgra bo 'di gtad do// smyo 'bog tu sod cig /gnyis par/ ha ha tri yaṃ dza dgra bo'i srog la rbad/ mig gi rnam shes tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can/ brgyal du chug cig /gsum par/ mu tri yaṃ dza/ srog la rbad/ sna'i rnam shes bdud nag po chig rgyugs lus nyams su/ bzhi par/ ru tra nā ga snying la yaṃ dza/ khrag la rbad/ sha la 'dus/ lce'i rnam shes klu bdud nag po sbrul zhon khyod la klu nad kyis sod cig /lnga par/ shu la yaṃ tri yaṃ dza shan sa mā ra ya rbad/ lus kyi rnam shes bdud btsan nag po khyi zhon khyod la grir gsod cig /drug par/ tri shar ra tsa rag thum ri li li dza dza/ yid kyi rnam shes bdud mo thod 'phreng can la/ yul mkhar bshig cig /bdun par/ a se rgyal po'i bu mo ral pa dmar po can khyod/ khrag nad kyis gsod cig /brgyad par/ ma tri yaṃ dza/ srog thug thug mā ra ya dza/ ga tri ma ra ya dza/ yid gyi rnam shes g.ya' ri dang gangs ri'i bdag mo ma bdud nag mo khyod la/ 'gag grir gsod cig de'i phyi'i mu khyud la/ e ra tsa rgyal po sa ma ya tri du dza/ tri ma yaṃ dza/ ma tri ma yaṃ dza/ ma ma tri tri yaṃ dza/ phu phu nā ga tri dza/ ban+dha ban+dha/ rā dza tri yaṃ dza/ dkar po tri ma yaṃ dza/ nag po tri ma yaṃ dza/

ga na ma yaṃ dza/ tri ma yaṃ dza/ sa tri ma yaṃ dza/ ra tsa tsa ti 'dus 'dus yaṃ dza/ dgra bo'i tsit+ta la 'dus 'dus/ ku ku ring ring bhes bhes/ bher bher dza/ ra dza he he dza/ nā ga ga phu phu tri dza/ nā ga 'du she/ yaṃ du she ya du she/ thibs thibs 'dus 'dus/ de'i phyir ling tshe bcu drug la/ dhe wa ra tsa sid dhi sa ma thibs dza rā dza a he sa ma ya shig tshangs pa'i rgyal po khyod la che ge mo 'di gtad do phung bar gyis shig gnyis oṃ ni rma tsa kru thuṃ/ bdud yab rje nag po khyod la/ dgar bo'i pha tshan rus thon/ gsum ti mi sha ku thun rāk+ṣa yak+ṣa/ ka dun yak+ṣa dza/ khyab 'jug rā hu la khyod la/ dgra bo'i zhing dang lo thog bzhi bdud tri nrir bzung*/ gnam khyi bdud po nag po khyod la/ rta nor la sogs pa/ lnga ma tri nrir dza/ gnyan gyi rgyal po bya khyung khyod la nor phyugs thams cad/ drug tri tsha pa la nrir gzung zhig phung zhig srin po'i rgyal po lag rings khyod la mkhar khyim thams cad/ bdun/ ma ma rag mo tsit+ta la rag mo srog la breng breng dza/ ma mo khrag 'thung ral pa can khyod la bud med thams cad zo cig /brgyad pa/ nā ga kro tī shwa ri srog la lhan lhan/ klu bdud nag po sbrul gyi ral pa can khyod la bu dang tsha bo zo cig /dgu par/ tsa la tsa la/ tsi li tsi li/ sig du li du bh+yo/ dhan dha rag sha mar mi bh+yo/ dza hi ha si ni rni tubs tubs/ srin po yak+ṣa me sbal khyod la yul mi thams cad/ phung du chug cig /bcu par/ oṃ ka ti ka rbad/ srin mo hab shang seng gdong khyod la/ bu mo dang tsha mo/ rlag par/ bcu gcig /oṃ gha dza wag dra ye swā hā/ dgra lha'i ded dpon khyod la nor thams cad brlag pa/ bcu gnyis/ ra dza srog la dung dung dza/ rgyal po rak+ṣa/ za byed khyod la mi brgyud thams cad rtsad nas chod cig med par gyis shig /bcu gsum/ oṃ suṃ tri rak+ṣa ya ma ra tsa dharma ra dza/ sa ma ya bh+yo/ btsan rgod yaṃ shud dmar po khyod la gser dngul zangs lcags thams cad/

bcu bzhi/ se khrag rul/ tsit+ta rol dbugs breng breng*/ se ra nag po khyod la/ rje dpon thams cad/ bco lnga/ tri ban sha ya nan/ yaṃ sha la hab hab/ gshin rje bya thul can khyod la/ dgra bo'i yul sa rnams gtad do// gshin rje'i pho brang thob cig /bcu drug nā ga ra tsa kro ta ni kro ta ni/ tri kha thun tri kha thun/ the 'gong rgyal bo he ban khyod la che ge mo'i bre srang la gzhal ba'i nor thams cad gtad do// brlag par gyis shig de'i phyi'i mu khyud la/ rgyud kyi mnan sngags kyi mthar/ dza ra dza a ho sa ma ya shog ra tsa sa man+ta ti sta stoṃ stoṃ/ ra dza tra tri dza lhan/ ro 'u ro 'u tri tri/ dza dza thibs thibs lhan dza/ tri dza tri dza dza/ ra dza tri tri dza dza/ ra dza tri ho/ ra tsa tri tri dza dza/ rgyug rgyug dza/ thibs thibs/ gnam drag ya/ a ko ta e yaṃ shig rig tri thun tri thun dza dza/ yaṃ yaṃ shig shig dza dza/ tri tri ro du/ yaṃ yaṃ/ na ga du shi yaṃ du she/ na ga dza/ tri tri dza dza/ lhan thibs dza dza/ tri yaṃ tri yaṃ/ du dza re dza/ tri tri yaṃ yaṃ thibs thibs/ du du/ she she/ tri tri/ yaṃ yaṃ/ na ga du she yaṃ yaṃ/ ā kar+sha ya/ ā kar+sha ya/ shig shig sarba sha trūṃ/ dhe ba thibs/ ra tri thuṃs/ nri mā ra ya thuṃs/ ba su dha ra ni/ sa ma ya thuṃs/ du na du na/ ban+dha ban+dha/ che ge mo mā ra ya nan/ de'i phyir 'chi bdag nag po khros pa'i gzugs bri'o// yum 'khor/ mu khyud la sogs pa 'dra ba la/ lte bar yaṃ/ phyogs bzhir yaṃ maṃ hraṃ raṃ/ de'i phyir bzhi snying*/ ma hā kā li sbyar ba/ de'i phyi'i rtsibs brgyad la/ ma hā kā li tsaṇ+ḍi kā/ mu khyud la/ oṃ nā ga kro ti shwa ri nā ga nag po baṃ/ che ge mo'i tsit+ta la rgyob/ mā ra ya rbad/ de'i mthar/ e ka he dun ya ma ra tsa sa do me ya/ ya ma do ru ṇa yo da ya/ ya ta yo ni/ ra ya k+ṣe ya/ yak+ṣe yats+tsha nir ma ya/ ya ma ra tsa dgra bo'i tsit+ta ro la shan/ re tsa smug rak+ta thibs dza/ sha la ma ta/ bhi ta ka la ru pa/

a nu ka ra tri/ dgra bo dza la dza la/ dza la pa ya/ dza la pa ya/ ta tsa ta tsa/ ma ra ma myag sod/ ya trig nan/ du du nan stoṃ stoṃ ya ya/ mā ra ya sod/ laṃ nan/ de'i rtsibs brgyad/ de la/ 'chi bdag nag po mche ba gtsigs pa khyod la dgra bo gtad do/ ya ma phe sha ka du dgra bo mā ra ya/ laṃ laṃ rbad/ lus brlag par gyis shig /gnyis/ 'chi bdag nag po drag po'i zhal khyod la dgra bo gtad do// ya ma nag po ka la rak+ṣa ma ra ya/ khaṃ khaṃ che ge mo'i ngag brlag par gyis shig /gsum/ 'chi bdag nag po rdza mgo khyod la dgra bo gtad do// ya ma ling du shan/ suṃ suṃ dza/ dgra bo'i yid thum thum/ yid thib tu chug cig /bzhi/ 'chi bdag nag po pad+ma'i spyan khyod la dgra bo gtad do// laṃ ya ma ro la khraṃ thung tsa sha baṃ/ ma ra ya/ raṃ raṃ rbad/ khrag skoms shig brlag par gyis shig /lnga/ 'chi bdag nag po spyan gcig pa'i gdong khyod la dgra bo gtad do// oṃ ya ma rak+ṣa tri sha du ru du ru dza/ ma ra ya duṃ duṃ rbad/ rtsa rgyus brlag par gyis shig /drug 'chi bdag nag po ru ru li khyod la dgra oṃ ya ma dan ti su ā kar+sha ya dza/ ma ra ya shag shag rbad/ rus brlag par gyis shig /bdun/ 'chi bdag nag po rme ba'i mdog khyod la dgra oṃ ya ma suṃ tri du na dza ya/ ma ra ya dul dul/ gdangs 'phrog par gyis shig /brgyad/ 'chi bdag nag po sha ba'i zhal khyod la dgra oṃ ya ma tri ling shaṅka dza/ mā ra ya yaṃ yaṃ rbad/ dbugs brlag par/ de'i phyi'i mu khyud la/ badz+ra rak+ṣa tsit+ta bzung*/ snying la kha rag rma sha rbad/ 'chi bdag sku sprul bdud rgyud ra tsa seng zhon khyod la dgra bo gtad do// myur du phung bar dza/ oṃ tri ta tsa dza tsa pa la a shug me swā hā/ 'chi bdag gsung sprul rak+ṣa tsa li sprel zhon khyod la dgra yul du rgyug la phung nyes sna tshogs thong*// oṃ bhi sha ma hā ra tsa swā hā/ 'chi bdag thugs sprul nag po srog gzan spyang zhon khyod la dgra dgra yul du rgyugs la ltas ngan sna tshogs thong cig

de'i phyir rtsibs brgyad la/ gza' bdud sbal gdong khrag mig ma la dgra bo gtad do// trag rak+ṣa tsa mun tri ru ru bh+yo/ dgra bo khrag nad kyis nges par gsod cig mā ra ya hūm̐ shi rbad/ gza'i rgyal po dgra can mgo pa/ ru ti haṃ shaṃ du tri bh+yo/ dgra bo smyo 'bog gis gsod cig mā ra ya ha thuṃ thuṃ rbad ya/ gza' bdud du ba mjug rings/ oṃ pa sha mi ki rā hu la/ dgra bo gri thabs kyis gsod cig mā ra ya rbad/ thib thib ya/ gza' rgyal byi nu ra dza/ oṃ ya ma rā tsa sarba me ya rā hu la bhi ru hu ra ya/ dgra bo chu nad kyis gsod cig dun ti rbad/ gza' rgyal ljang sngon drag po/ oṃ na ga tri shaṃ yaṃ raṃ du ya dgra bo mes gsod cig srog tshig mā ra ya rbad/ gza' rgyal bi tri pa ṭa/ oṃ ra tri bhi du tshur ya/ dgra bo rims nad kyis gsod cig mā ra ya rbad/ gza'i rgyal po he le khyab pa/ oṃ pu pa tri/ ru ra ru ra/ sa gha na/ dgra bo zha nad kyis gsod cig laṃ bo nan rbad/ gza'i rgyal bo sgra gcan 'dzin la dgra nad dang grir gsod cig mā ra ya/ de'i mu khyud la/ hri rak+ṣa rā hu la ra tri chum/ nri mā ra ya rbad/ ke ta ke ta rā hu la/ ram trig sarba du na du na/ ke shaṃ na ga tri rag sha ma ma za za/ 'graṃ 'graṃ/ ha la ha la/ nag po kiṅka du ru su ru/ dgra bo nad du ya du ya/ phob phob/ thib thib/ du raṃ thim/ yaṃ yaṃ thu tsa mā ra ya/ phung shig ya/ de'i phyir ling tshe bcu drug mu khyud dang bcas pa yab 'khor bzhin no// de'i phyir yum sbal mgo dgu pa sbrul mjug can sbrul zhags dang nad rkyal 'dzin pa bri'o// rdzas ni/ bri gzhi zhing lpags ro ras sam dug shog mdze gri/ mi khyi btsod yugs sa mo'i mngal khrag rgya tshos/ rdza brag thang khrom/ yungs kar/ ldong ros/ bab bla/ ke tshe/ shang rtse/ tang rtse/ ro sol/ klu gnas chur sbyar bas sna tsha/ mi rus sam bya rog sgro rtsa smyug gu/ thal chen mtshal/ skyer tsher khan dha/

khrag sna khyi nag 'o ma byug rdzas/ tshon skud lnga dkri pa'i/ mdze mon rabs chad rta drel gyi thod pa'am/ lcags zangs khams sa'i sbal pa/ glang ru/ mnan pa'i snod/ sbrul lpags gtums byed/ ram bu/ yungs dkar nag ke shang*/ thang khrom/ dug phye/ zangs/ lcags/ rdo/ te lo'i sha/ mu zi/ chu dag rta dang*/ khyi dmar po'i khrag skyes pa grir shi ba'i khrag phag rgod mche ba rnams nang du/ ga pur/ tsan dan/ gla rtsi/ gu gul/ 'brug rus/ khang dud/ rma bya'i mdongs/ klu sman/ phyir byug pa'i rdzas so// bar ling ni/ dgra gzugs yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams pa sbrul gyis bcings pa lce kha nas phyungs te lte bar sleb pa'i steng du rdo rje rgya gram/ zur bzhi mchod rten rtse mo nang bstan/ lte bar dza kha sprod kyi dbus su nri/ dgra bo che ge mo khug aṅku sha dzaḥspyi bor 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad la hūm̐ ma ma/ dpral bar rus/ lce rtsar dung dung*/ phrag par dzaḥdang hūm̐ mtshan mtshams/ yuṃ she gnyis/ khrig ma/ mā dang ra/ bla la bla gdags/ pus mor baṃ dang ho/ lham sgrog 'ching sar rbad dang ya/ byin par bri zha zha gnyis/ rkang mthil du yaṃ gnyis/ phyi bzhi snying mnan sngags dmod pa/ de'i phyir khram ris khungs su dza bris pas skor ba'o// bsad ling ni/ 'khor lo mu khyud can rtsibs brgyad nang du blta ba'i lte bar lid+ga tshon sna tshogs lus la zug pa yi ge sngar bzhin/ rtsibs brgyad la a ya ma du ru tsa sha na/ mu khyud la bzhi snying*/ phyir mu khyud gcig la dmod pa/ de'i phyir khraṃ sngar bzhin/ sreg ling*/ rū pa de lta bu la bzhi snying sreg sngags kyis bskor ba/ de'i phyir khram de'i bar la dza steng 'og raṃ bris bas bskor ba'o// 'khor lo gzhan rnams 'bod dus sngags la dregs pa rnams bstim/ rbad dus de rnams kyi dgra bo'i bla bkug ste ling gar bstim pas de dam nyams dgra bo nyam thag par bsam/ dbye dus lha dang phral/

bsad dus dam can rnams kyi mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis gzir bar bsam mo// lhag par gtad mnan gang byed na klu bdud nag po'i 'bod rbad bsad khram btab bzhi shes par bya ste/ e phe sha ka du bh+ruṃ nag po ti pa tsa nā ga rak+ṣa/ kro ti shwa ri/ nā ga du na/ nā ga du na/ he li he li/ nā ga 'dus 'dus/ sa ma hūm̐ dzaḥdang po'o// hūm̐ nā ga rak+ṣa ru tra ka la bh+yo/ dgra bo'i snying la baṃ ril/ tsit+ta la rgyab drag thur snying thur/ snying gul gul/ myag myag rtsa bzhi skum/ shan shan/ srog la shan/ thur thur dgra bo'i tsit+ta rbad bh+yo/ sa nā ga ha la tsa la ring*/ dgra bo'i snying la thuṃ bh+yo/ nā ga ra tsa ti pa tsa ra ya dgra bo'i dbugs la bh+yo/ mdze gri nag po thuṃ la rbad bh+yo/ gnyis pa'o// e nag po ti pa tsa la// nā ga rak+ṣa/ dgra bo'i snying la mā ra ya dza/ klu bdud nag po na ga dgra bo'i snying la ya/ sa nā ga phu ye phu ye/ du phu ya dza/ dgra bo che ge mo'i sha khrag la mā ra ya rbad rbad dza/ gsum pa'o/ hūm̐ dze phe sha ka du/ nā ga ra tsa tri liṃ shaṃ ka du/ ya ma ra tsa/ sa nā ga du ne du ne/ do shing khraṃ khraṃ/ bzhi pa'o// klu bdud srog sngags la/ trig nan hur thuṃ dzaḥmā ra ya rbad/ daṃ daṃ sa ma ya/ yaṃ raṃ khaṃ laṃ nan rbad rbad bh+yo/ 'jug kar des brab bo// de nas sngags gzhan rnams byang bur bris la nur 'don thub na bzang ngo*// 'byams sdug la/ 'di bgrang*/ badz+ra ra tri ya bh+yo/ sa ma ya sha ma baṃ baṃ bh+yo/ hri la hriṃ hriṃ/ kha la rak+ṣa bh+yo/ dgra bo phung phung*/ shig shig dul dul/ ya yā/ raṃ raṃ/ khaṃ khaṃ/ suṃ suṃ/ yaṃ yaṃ/ du ru tsa na/ dgra bo myur du phung*/ shig sod ya bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo/ tri tri tri/ bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo/ zhes bgrang ngo*/ yang na rim pa gsum pa yi/ gsang sngags ma hā kā la yi// 'phrin las khyad par dgod par bya// 'dis ni shin tu mngon spyod myur// thabs dang shes rab khyad par dang*// steng 'og bar gyi dbye ba yis// 'dis mgyogs byed kyi 'khor lo bstan// mu khyud rim pa gsum bskor la// nang ma che bar bya de la// mgon po yi ge bcu bdun pa// de'i mthar/

'chi bdag mgo dgu srangs la bzhur cig nag po ti pa tsa ya srang la lha ma srin sde brgyad srang la klu bdud kyi pho brang srang la dgra bo che ge mo'i yul khams phung bar gyis shig lha ma srin sde brgyad ma 'jam zhig bar ma rtsibs drug la hūm̐/ phyi ma mo bcu bdun pa'i mthar tri dza hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ra tri sha sha ma ru tra khu kha khu kha nag po ti pa tsa khu kha khu kha/ de'i phyi rim la mgon po'i sku/ yum gyi 'khor lo gzhan 'dra la srog sngags bsgyur ba tsam mo// zhes dpal ye shes mgon po'i drag po'i las la dgos pa'i 'khor lo'i gzer sngags 'chang pad+ma dkar pos bgyis pa'o// gang zhig sangs rgyas bstan gnod 'gro la 'tshe// nag po'i mthu ni bu lon ltar 'ded mdun// 'khor lo 'di ni 'chi bdag bdud po'i kha// mi bzad mche ba gzings pa mngon sum pa'o// mad+galaṃ/// /
